item.title: A Pixar director turns a self-important TED Talk into sci-fi with In The Blink Of An Eye
item.description: In The Blink Of An Eye is smaller-scale and more grown-up than other live-action features from Pixar alumni. It's still bad.

item.title: Paramount hires potential HR liability, Max Landis, to write G.I. Joe reboot
item.description: Showing no compunction about his abuse allegations, Paramount has tapped disgraced nepo-baby Max Landis to write a reboot of G.I. Joe.

item.title: Alice Rohrwacher finds her Three Incestuous Sisters: Dakota Johnson, Saoirse Ronan, and Jessie Buckley
item.description: The latest from the La Chimera filmmaker will reteam with Josh O'Connor for Three Incestuous Sisters, based on the bestseller.

item.title: Radiohead condemns ICE for slapping the band's songs over its videos: "Go fuck yourselves"
item.description: The band did not mince words in response to an ICE video that slapped 1997's "Let Down" over the organization's self-justifying efforts.

item.title: R.I.P. Neil Sedaka: Hit singer-songwriter dead at 86
item.description: Sedaka was “a true rock and roll legend, an inspiration to millions, but most importantly, at least to those of us who were lucky enough to know him, an incredible human being who will be deeply missed,” his family shared in a statement.

item.title: Campers arrive for In A Violent Nature 2's teaser trailer
item.description: The sequel to 2024's hookiest slasher lurches into theaters later this year.
